description:
A recognized symptom (optionally red-flag) that routes free-text input to guidance.

NOTE: this is a RETRIEVAL key, not a risk model. `pl_terms` are the phrases a user might
type; the matcher folds Polish diacritics and matches on these. Guidance is categorical.

pl_label.description: Canonical Polish name of the symptom.
pl_label.title: Pl Label

pl_terms.description: Lay-language aliases/phrasings a user might enter.
pl_terms.title: Pl Terms

red_flag.description: Whether this is an alarm symptom warranting prompt POZ consultation.
red_flag.title: Red Flag

age_context_min.description: Age above which the red flag is emphasized.
age_context_min.title: Age Context Min

caveat_pl.description: Honest context, e.g. that most such symptoms are not cancer.
caveat_pl.title: Caveat Pl

title: SymptomPattern
